# What should you charge for that cake?

> Free cake pricing calculator for home bakers and cake decorators: ingredients, decoration, hours, delivery, overhead and fees in, a price per cake and per serving out, with break-even, target and premium tiers. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
